title: 2010 HMMT November Guts Problem 16
statement: Triangle \(A B C\) is given in the plane. Let \(A D\) be the angle bisector of \(\angle B A C\); let \(B E\) be the altitude from \(B\) to \(A D\), and let \(F\) be the midpoint of \(A B\). Given that \(A B=28, B C=33, C A=37\), what is the length of \(E F\) ?

solutions.text: \(14 \triangle A B E\) is a right triangle, and \(F\) is the midpoint of the hypotenuse (and therefore the circumcenter), so \(E F=B F=A F=14\).
